title: Three Weeks in Tanzania: North, South and the Coast
excerpt: Three weeks in Tanzania: the northern parks, the wild south and the coast in one trip.
body:
## Week 1: the north

Arusha, Tarangire, Serengeti and Ngorongoro.

## Week 2: the south

Fly to [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/) for three nights and continue to [Nyerere](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/) for a boat safari and walking.

## Week 3: the coast

Fly to Zanzibar: Stone Town and the beach. Or try [Pemba](/blog/pemba-island-guide/) or [Mafia](/blog/mafia-island-whale-sharks/).

## Why this route

You see the contrast between the famous north and the wild south, and end relaxed.

## Season

Best in the dry season, June to October.

## Alternatives

Replace the south with Kilimanjaro, or add [Rwanda's gorillas](/blog/tanzania-and-rwanda-gorillas/).

[Plan your three weeks](/travel-proposal/).
